I grow wheat on this plot because it feeds my family and I can sell the surplus at market. I will buy DAP and urea from the cooperative — without fertilizer the wheat grows too thin and the yield is poor. I have some savings from last season but not enough for everything, so I will plant the seed I saved from my best stalks and mix manure from my animals into the soil. My children and I will do most of the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, but I will hire a few day laborers when the weeding and threshing are heavy.
